\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}
\usepackage[thms=definition+theorem]{blueprint}
\begin{document}

\begin{definition}\label{def:foo}
\lean{Foo.foo}
\leanok
A foo.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}\label{def:baz}
\lean{Foo.baz}
A baz, not yet formalized.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:bar}
\lean{Foo.bar}
\uses{def:foo}
\discussion{42}
Bar holds.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
\uses{def:foo}
Trivial.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:qux}
\uses{thm:bar, def:baz}
Qux is planned only.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
